statement: table_plan() starts a plan from an ARD (or a finished table, or records): it names the key across (cols) and the keys down (rows); nothing runs until the plan is used.
plan_apply() runs a plan into the table, its pages (rtftables) or a stage between, the same way every time.
plan_layers() shows what a plan declares: its layers by verb, and the columns its table will print.
plan_template() writes a plan's code from a named template of verbs.
plan_header_tokens() lists the tokens a column header can say ({col}, {n}, ...) for a plan; plan_n_candidates() lists the populations a header's {n} can count.

plan_cells() says how each cell is made from the ARD's statistics: a token template per kind (continuous, categorical, ...), per variable or per context; a statistic missing is shown as declared (na).
plan_digits() sets the digits of the cells' numbers (and the rounding), by statistic or by column of a finished table.
plan_levels() sets the order of a key's values (and a value's printed text); plan_labels() sets a variable's printed label.
plan_total() adds a Total column from the ARD's overall rows, at the position given.
plan_stat_groups() groups a record's statistics into named groups of rows.
plan_filter() drops the rows a condition over the record names (any column, with or without their parents).
plan_compare() adds columns read from comparison records (a test's p-value, a difference and its CI), at the position given.
plan_sort() orders the rows by keys or by a statistic, descending with a minus sign, keeping the groups together.
plan_nest() puts a variable's rows under a level of another.
plan_stub() makes the row headings: the key columns into one stub column, indented by level, with a group's summary row.
plan_col_header() writes the column header (lines, spans, token values such as {n}) over the printed columns.
plan_columns() sets the printed columns' widths (by name), decimal alignment, row-title columns and cell format.
plan_hide() keeps columns from printing while they still pace the pages.
plan_cell_style() styles cells: bold, italic, alignment, colour, background, borders, indent; by column, header or a condition over the row.
plan_style() sets the whole table's look: its border preset and borders, header look, alignment, width.
plan_empty() writes a table of no events as one row saying so (and a footnote), when the table has no row or its overall row is 0.
plan_paginate_rows() paginates the rows within a row budget, keeping groups together as asked, with a continued label.
plan_paginate_group() makes a page (or a section) per value of a column, its heading from a template.
plan_paginate_cols() cuts the columns into blocks of pages, carrying the stub, the header sliced per block.
plan_row_group() groups the body's rows by a column's runs, a repeated value printed once.
plan_blanks() puts blank rows between groups, after each record of a listing, at the top or end of a page; where = none takes a listing's away.
plan_listing() makes a plan a listing: its printed columns (listing_col()) and the listing's layout.
plan_titles() and plan_footnotes() put a title block above and a footnote block below every page (or one per page).
plan_after() runs the user's own functions over the finished pages.
